def tryb(tb,names_t,Ab,names_A):
    cols=[];nm=[]
    for a,na in zip(tb,names_t):
        for b,nb in zip(Ab,names_A):
            cols.append(a*b); nm.append(na+"*"+nb)
    X=np.column_stack(cols)
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,y,rcond=None)[0]
    r=y-X@c
    return np.mean(r**2)/np.var(y), c, nm
